Description_en: I was transported from another world. To return to my original world, I am working to restore an ancient ritual.
Name: HERO_NAME_Basic

Description_en: A soldier who once guarded the sanctuary. Originally just a foot soldier, he was thrust into the front lines of the war against demons. In that battle, he awakened to his innate survival skills, and over the long course of the holy war, he survived and became a master of combat.
Name: HERO_NAME_Guardian

Description_en: A clown of the western desert region. He has become one with the cacti, to the point where even monsters no longer recognize him as an enemy.
Name: HERO_NAME_Cactus

Description_en: A berserker wearing a helmet adorned with bull horns. Once the champion of the Eastern Kingdom's arena, he easily survived the demonic invasion. Now, he satisfies his thirst for battle by hunting demons.
Name: HERO_NAME_Berserker

Description_en: The princess of the Eastern Kingdom. Her secret hobby is crafting bombs, and she enjoys blowing up abandoned buildings. True to her royal lineage, she also possesses some magical abilities.
Name: HERO_NAME_Princess

Description_en: A ranger famous as a wandering mercenary. Though highly skilled, he is perhaps even more well-known for his bald head. He is currently chasing his master, who is branded a regicide, but he firmly believes his master would never have killed the king.
Name: HERO_NAME_Ranger

Description_en: A descendant of an ancient warrior tribe who feels uncontrollable rage upon seeing demons. He travels in search of his origins. On the battlefield, he appears like the wind, strikes down enemies with whirlwind slashes like a storm, and vanishes once more on the hunt.
Name: HERO_NAME_Barbarian

Description_en: Once, she was merely a gentle dairy cow. But when the demonic invasion turned her lush green pasture into a wasteland and left her with nothing to eat, she was consumed by fury and became a warrior. Now, she is determined to eliminate the demons who caused it all. Today again, she embarks on a journey to reclaim her meadow.
Name: HERO_NAME_Cow

Description_en: The demons' ruthless slaughter shattered the balance of the world, forcing even neutral spirits to join the war. Magma, the spirit of the earth, will crush the demons and restore harmony.
Name: HERO_NAME_Magma

Description_en: A legendary demon-hunting gunman. He founded his own demon hunter guild and possesses combat power rivaling that of an entire nation. During the holy war, he eliminated a high-ranking demon disguised as the king, contributing to the war’s end—but as a result, he is now wanted as a regicide. His disciples from across the land are currently hunting him down.
Name: HERO_NAME_DevilHunter

Description_en: Drake, the dragon knight, was once a real dragon living in the northern mountains. When the demonic invasion destroyed his nest, he set out on a journey to reclaim it. Realizing that defeating demons requires human cooperation, he now roams the world polymorphed in human form to earn their favor.
Name: HERO_NAME_Dragon

Description_en: A messenger of love who cherishes peace. Even today, he fires arrows of love, proclaiming affection in a world left in ruins.
Name: HERO_NAME_Cupid

Description_en: The rightful heir of the Iga ninja clan. She was the sole survivor when their hidden village in the northern mountains was invaded by demons. Though still lacking in skill, she is training hard to become the greatest ninja. She believes her fellow disciples and masters are still alive, and one day, she plans to reclaim the ninja village.
Name: HERO_NAME_Cat

Description_en: The pirate captain of the eastern coast. She rose to power with a single merciless gun and used her charming appearance as a weapon to eliminate countless rivals. Now that the world has plunged into chaos, she sees it as an opportunity to expand her power and become the strongest pirate in the world.
Name: HERO_NAME_Pirate

Description_en: A hero summoned from another world. In his own world, he was a ruthless enforcer of justice who crushed rioters. Now, with modern equipment brought from his home world, he delivers a new taste of fire to the demons of this realm.
Name: HERO_NAME_Cop

Description_en: A high-ranking elementalist dispatched from the Arcane Division. Though the division rarely intervenes in worldly affairs, it judged that the balance of the world had been too greatly disturbed by external forces—and thus sent one of its top sorcerers. He clears all obstacles before him with destructive fire magic.
Name: HERO_NAME_Flame

Description_en: The elves of the western Illusion Forest were an isolated faction that refused contact with anyone. However, the corruption from another world tainted their sacred trees from the roots, forcing the displaced elves to interact with others. As the elder of the elves, she was sent as an emissary, yet she still clings to the elven sense of superiority.
Name: HERO_NAME_Elf

Description_en: The god of thunder and war descended from Olympus. With a boisterous and battle-loving nature, he travels from battlefield to battlefield. The chaos of this world is deeper and fiercer than any he has seen before, igniting his thirst for war like never before.
Name: HERO_NAME_Thunder

Description_en: He is a great archangel from the celestial realm. With a single touch, all demons in his sight vanish and saints are revived. Yet even with his omnipotent power, this demonic invasion proved too great to stop. He suspects that forces from another world are involved and is now investigating the incident.
Name: HERO_NAME_HolyKnight

Description_en: The commander of the empire’s secret assassination unit. Wracked with guilt for failing to protect the king during the holy war, he went into seclusion to train. Now, having completed his training and emerged as the most formidable assassin, he sets out once more in search of a new master to serve.
Name: HERO_NAME_Assassin

Description_en: A legendary hero who once saved another world was merged with game data while playing a mech game and was summoned once again as Robot Blaster. Now, with a body of steel, the hero fights once more against the darkness threatening the fantasy world.
Name: HERO_NAME_Blaster

Description_en: The ruler of the northern glacier region. Even the strongest corrupting forces could not taint her. However, all of her subordinates fell to corruption, and she could no longer maintain her throne as the empress of the north. She now wanders the world, seeking a way to cleanse the corruption and reclaim her lost power.
Name: HERO_NAME_Frost

Description_en: Once a legendary paladin of ancient times, he overcame death itself through transcendent holy power. He saved countless lives and was celebrated across the ages. Yet even he could not escape aging. Though his kingdom fell and his body decayed to nothing, he remained—unable to die. Now, no one remembers that he was once human; only his unwavering sense of justice continues to drive him forward.
Name: HERO_NAME_Skull

Description_en: An unrecorded being pulled into another world by a dimensional rift. Unlike you, the celebrated hero, they survived this strange land alone, fighting only with a sword.
Name: HERO_NAME_Hana
